metadata.description: Default asset mapping taxonomy for macro event intelligence. This file is configuration, not application logic, so market assumptions can be reviewed and changed without code edits.

research_basis.source: State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
research_basis.rationale: SPY is used as the broad U.S. equity market proxy because it tracks the S&P 500.

research_basis.source: State Street Select Sector SPDR ETFs
research_basis.rationale: XLE, XLK, and XLF are widely used sector ETF proxies for energy, technology, and financials.
QQQ is used as a large-cap growth and technology-sensitive proxy because it tracks the Nasdaq-100.
TIP is used as an inflation-linked bond proxy because it tracks U.S. Treasury inflation-protected securities.
